interpretation.max_selection: One posterior maximum-absolute Smooth2 input in predetermined group108 per saved row. Full h is already computed; this is a diagnostic observer, not a pre-W1 selector.
interpretation.controls: Per-row minimum-absolute one-channel deletion (mostly already quantized zero) and whole group108 deletion. Minimum is matched channel count, not matched contribution magnitude.
interpretation.floating_point: FP32 fixed-gate component projections and their observed sum identity are separate from BF16 W2 finite differences and actual residual writeback. Standard gamma estimate is a diagnostic reference, not a backend certificate.
interpretation.evidence_scope: Eight saved160-row panels nested within two exposed sources/two expert steps/two depths. No new independent source or all-depth/trajectory coverage.
interpretation.open_discriminator: W2 shape control registered separately; semantic output functions and faithful suffix/video remain open.

protocol_deviation: The frozen protocol says bytewise noop identity, but sampled driver uses torch.equal on BF16 numeric values. Signed-zero byte identity is unestablished. Raw code/protocol/RUN preserved; subsequent full-shape scope uses explicit int16 bit checks.
